allowed_next_actions: Prepare a narrow metadata request through the existing Apps Script for the exact file ID, relevant checksum and version fields, size, ownership, trash state, and download capability.
Verify which fields are actually returned and use stable metadata around any later local comparison.

recommended_next_step.now: Deliver a dated evidence table and ordered read-only verification plan. Mark all removal/upload actions as unexecuted and distinguish historical matches, fresh stated matches, incomplete checks, and uncertain outcomes.
recommended_next_step.first_follow_up_check: Reconcile pending-upload read-only to avoid compounding its uncertain outcome; then finish pagination, create a fresh read-only inventory, and fill checksum/recoverability gaps.
before_proposing_release: Measure actual local allocated bytes and Google One quota usage/free capacity across the existing subscription; do not infer that a duplicate will free its nominal size or that an archive upload fits.
Confirm full media groups, stable cloud content identity, user control, and a demonstrated or explicitly bounded recovery path.
Resolve sync propagation and define the exact local release method, its cloud effect, rollback/restore path, and post-action verification.
Present the concrete item list and projected space benefit for later execution authorization; request no paid upgrade.
recommended_next_step.overall_assessment: The supplied observations support several useful evidence states, but none establishes a presently authorized, fully checked local deletion. The strongest immediate improvements are resolving uncertainty and completing the verification boundaries.
